proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4272 *goḍḍa gives Nepali goṛo and Hindi goṛā leg. Dang gora repeats the regional leg comparison with plain rhotic articulation retained. Exact survey form gora is preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4147.3 gāvī gives Hindi and neighboring gāi/gāy cow. These Dang/Kathoriya gaiya-like forms match the already reviewed feminine cow expansion, retaining the final -ya and nasal or raised glide details as regional qualifications. Exact survey form gəⁱya is preserved.
